tickets.name: Alice Vance
tickets.subject: Unable to reset account password via magic link
tickets.description: I requested a password reset email twice today, but clicking the magic link leads to an expired token error page immediately.

tickets.name: Marcus Brody
tickets.subject: Double charged for annual subscription renewal
tickets.description: My credit card statement shows two identical charges of $199.00 on August 5th. Please refund the duplicate transaction.

tickets.name: Elena Rostova
tickets.subject: CSV export truncates special characters in UTF-8
tickets.description: When exporting the audit logs to CSV, non-ASCII accent characters like "é" and "ñ" get garbled into replacement symbols.

tickets.name: Devon Miles
tickets.subject: Add Dark Mode theme toggle to dashboard
tickets.description: Our support team works late shifts and would greatly appreciate a native dark mode theme option in the agent queue panel.

tickets.name: Sarah Connor
tickets.subject: API returns HTTP 500 error when uploading large JSON payload
tickets.description: Every POST request to /api/tickets with payloads larger than 50KB fails with an unhandled server error.

tickets.name: Arthur Pendelton
tickets.subject: Need tax invoice for Q3 billing
tickets.description: Please send the official VAT invoice for our Q3 corporate billing payment made last week.

tickets.name: Claire Dearing
tickets.subject: SSO login redirect loop with Okta SAML
tickets.description: Users authenticating via SAML 2.0 Okta integration get trapped in a redirect loop after entering credentials.

tickets.name: Hugo Reyes
tickets.subject: Webhook notification delivery delay
tickets.description: Webhook events for ticket status updates are arriving 15 to 20 minutes after the actual action occurred.

tickets.name: John Connor
tickets.subject: Updated payment method not reflecting on account
tickets.description: I updated my billing card details yesterday, but the portal still displays my old expired Visa card.

tickets.name: David Lightman
tickets.subject: Requesting bulk export API endpoint
tickets.description: We need a REST API endpoint to dump all ticket metrics into our internal analytics data lake nightly.
